ruleset.name: test-conventions
ruleset.description: Tests must be linear (setup → action → assert): no control statements (docs/DESIGN.md §13.2). Applies to test sources only; production code and the e2e/integration harness helpers are excluded (they legitimately use control flow).

rule.name: NoControlStatementsInTests
rule.message: Tests must be linear: no if/else, for, while, do, switch, ternary, or try
rule.description: Each test follows setup → action → assert with no branching or loops.
